messages:
jin: Postmortem follow-up for last night's GPU surge. Capturing owners, timelines, and short-term mitigations. TL;DR: tenant quota exhaustion + scheduler backpressure. I'll track actions here. postmortem: https://postmortems.redwood/gpu-surge-2026

maria: I can own the quota remediation. Need target headroom numbers and exact tenants to bump. :thinking_face:

alex: Scheduler tuning seems to be a low-risk win (priority/preemption window). I can prototype a change and run a canary. Estimate: 48–72h to validate.

sam: I'll take headroom planning and the runbook writeup. Proposal: +15% reserved capacity during peak windows + a small burst pool for short spikes. Will draft rollback steps.

ops-bot: Incident REM-5738 created and linked to this thread. Actions added to tracker.

liz: For quota checks: run `kubectl get resourcequotas -n inference -o yaml | grep -A3 gpu` — you can see current allocations per namespace.

maria: Thanks @liz — maria to coordinate with infra for spare quota request. Tentative target: 2026-03-30 EOD.

alex: Scheduler change plan (short):
```
1) set `scheduler.max_preemption=3`
2) enable short preemption window = 10s
3) rollout canary to 10% nodes, monitor 99p latency and preempt rate
```
I'll open the PR today.

jin: Owners & timelines (proposed):
- quota requests -> @maria -> due 2026-03-30
- scheduler tuning PR + canary -> @alex -> due 2026-03-25
- headroom runbook + rollout plan -> @sam -> due 2026-03-24
Any objections or additions?

maria: Sounds good. We also need a cost estimate for the reserved headroom before approvals. @nicole-finance can you weigh in?

nicole-finance: Cost estimate for +15% reserved GPU capacity: approx +$8k/month. I'll drop a short spreadsheet and approval path by EOD.

sam: Draft runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/gpu-headroom-draft — includes detection, mitigation, and rollback. Adding play-by-play commands.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scheduler/pull/482 — test plan and metrics in description.

maria: Cloud quota ticket CLOUD-1299 submitted to provider with requested increases and justification. Linking here for visibility.

jin: I'll set a weekly follow-up until all actions are closed. Next sync: Friday 10:00 PT (standup in #incidents). I'll also add these owners to the remediation tracker.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-27 10:00 PT for thread 1733337777 in #incidents.

liz: I'll add alerts for preemption spike (>5/min) and scheduler backpressure (pod pending > 2m).

jin: Thanks everyone — I'll update the tracker with exact tickets and PR links. Please post updates here when you have them so I can mark items closed. :thumbsup:
